path_basis: Replacement paths on feat/clean-rewrite, with the preserved baseline under legacy/. Frontend views retain their existing paths and interface; changes adapt contracts/state only unless a specific polish improvement is separately justified.
status_semantics: Package acceptance remains planned until integrated evidence satisfies every criterion. Source implementation and current verification are tracked in results/integration.md and feature reports; a planned acceptance status does not mean source work has not started.

dependency_semantics.start_after: Each listed producer publishes the reviewed required public/private interface or fixture subset for initial work (contract-ready), not its complete implementation. Later branches obtain their producer interfaces before development; finish_after still requires complete integration.
dependency_semantics.finish_after: Completion requires actual integrated producer/consumer behavior, not fixtures alone.

shared_ownership: Shared registrations, schema order, generated output and lockfiles are integrated by their declared owner. See delivery.md.

packages.name: public-contracts
acceptance: Rust serialization and generated TypeScript agree on tagged unions, optional fields, explicit nulls and numeric bounds.
Only sanitized public DTOs are exported; install, launch, account and update contracts retain distinct lifecycles.

packages.name: composition-build
acceptance: Replacement builds with isolated application identity and data root.
A minimal build skeleton exists before public contract compilation. One owner integrates registrations/dependency changes as feature contracts arrive; no global service locator.

packages.name: scenario-fixtures
acceptance: Fixed provider payloads and profile trees have provenance and independently reviewed expected outcomes.
Fake Java exposes controlled output, stall, exit and descendants; fixture secrets are synthetic and filesystem canaries detect unrelated mutation.

packages.name: metadata-storage
acceptance: Settings and feature-local metadata persist with relational constraints and bounded transactions.
Storage experiment proves recovery behavior and reduces custom persistence ownership; corruption preserves files and closes unsafe mutation.

packages.name: managed-files
acceptance: Scoped roots reject escaping paths, unsafe links, collisions and replacement identities.
Staging/publication/delete primitives retain explicit obligations across cancellation and crash; existing external libraries remain supported.

packages.name: library-lifecycle
acceptance: Current and retiring root generations are explicit; operations, guards and receipts retain exact pins across async work and settlement.
Library selection and reset exclude new incompatible work and wait for retained generations; source/root replacement and active-work races never mint stale authority.

packages.name: provider-io
acceptance: Shared download client enforces permitted origins, redirect policy, timeouts, response and decompression limits.
Checksum policy follows provider evidence, handles sources without hashes explicitly, and never publishes partial bytes.

packages.name: task-lifetimes
acceptance: Accepted work survives caller cancellation and joins at shutdown.
Per-target and shared-artifact exclusion, lock order, bounded work and revisioned snapshots prevent conflicting effects without a generic durable journal.

packages.name: api-transport
acceptance: Capability/origin rejection runs before effects; media and fresh stream tickets remain narrowly scoped.

Atomic snapshot/subscription, stale revision rejection and reconnect converge without resubmitting mutations in browser/transport integration. Desktop-shell supplies initial packaged WebView proof and artifact-delivery supplies the full installed matrix.

packages.name: desktop-shell
acceptance: Existing platform chrome, bootstrap, opener and close/restart behavior remain available with confined native authority.

Initial installed shell proves authenticated JSON/media/SSE, navigation/CSP and active-work shutdown on the development host; artifact-delivery owns the complete installed-platform matrix before transport retirement.

packages.name: ui-composition
acceptance: Existing primitives, design tokens, route restoration, overlays, focus and error/loading boundaries remain.
Feature clients share one authoritative domain snapshot each and root registration/CSS order has one owner.

packages.name: settings
acceptance: Non-Guardian config fields, feature overrides, effective defaults and per-instance inheritance preserve behavior.
Invalid patches and stale concurrent edits fail explicitly; corrupt persisted data is preserved.

packages.name: instances
acceptance: Create/list/edit/restart retain identity, settings and library selection; missing external library is handled explicitly.
Accepted mutations survive dropped callers, reject conflicting lifecycle work and never infer ownership from display names.

packages.name: instance-deletion
acceptance: Keep-files and delete-files are distinct explicit intents with correct source preservation.
Precommit failure restores or preserves state; postcommit cleanup remains tracked; restart and replacement-identity cases cannot delete unrelated data.

packages.name: instance-duplication
acceptance: Duplicate copies required user data and overrides to a fresh identity without mutating the source.
Partial copy, cancellation, naming collision and metadata commit failures leave no falsely usable destination.

packages.name: java-discovery
acceptance: Managed/system/custom Java discovery preserves compatible version and architecture selection.
Missing, incompatible, replaced and hanging executables yield bounded typed outcomes without hidden override changes.

packages.name: java-installation
acceptance: Ordinary managed Java provisioning and reuse verify the installed runtime.
Concurrent install, checksum failure and cancellation before/after publication preserve ready state and explicit settlement.

packages.name: version-catalog
acceptance: Current version families, classification, ordering, inheritance and installed loader labels match reviewed baseline fixtures.
Stale/empty/malformed catalogs remain distinguishable; provider identifiers are not parsed in the UI.

packages.name: installer-primitives
acceptance: Shared profile composition, archive extraction and installer processor execution cover each retained loader strategy.
Traversal, output mismatch, processor cancellation and descendant cleanup have explicit verified outcomes.

packages.name: vanilla-installation
acceptance: Vanilla manifests, assets, libraries, natives and client artifacts form a verified runnable installation.
Interrupted publication and retry never expose partially installed versions as ready.

packages.name: install-queue
acceptance: An early checkpoint queues real Vanilla installation; full completion waits for all four retained loaders through the public queue and event/status routes.
Queue ordering, remove/retry, hydration, progress and terminal states remain consistent across all views.
Repeated intent, cancellation, restart, dropped streams and stale events cannot duplicate work or falsely terminalize an install.

packages.name: fabric-loader
acceptance: Supported-version/build listing and exact Fabric installation preserve historical and current profile shapes.
Representative retained compatibility cases install and launch; unsupported or incomplete catalog rows remain unavailable.

packages.name: quilt-loader
acceptance: Quilt mapping, game/build stability and exact profiles preserve supported versions.
Checksumless upstream cases and incompatible Java/library combinations have explicit handling and runnable fixtures.

packages.name: forge-loader
acceptance: Earliest archive overlays, legacy FML installers and modern processor installations remain supported as characterized.
Promotions/build identity, failed processors and base/child publication boundaries pass; no silent historical-version cut.

packages.name: neoforge-loader
acceptance: Numbering eras, supported Minecraft mapping, beta-only targets and exact installer profiles are preserved.
Processor/output verification and failed publication leave no false readiness.

packages.name: launch-planning
acceptance: Private command construction preserves version inheritance, authentication placeholders, memory/window/JVM and loader behavior.
Hard readiness and reserved/invalid argument checks block with safe errors; planning does not silently repair, strip overrides or spawn.

packages.name: game-sessions
acceptance: One owned session per instance supports start, running, stop, exit, restart and accurate retained public state.
Caller loss, stop races, shutdown and failure reap owned process descendants and reject stale attempt completions.
Low-level session admission accepts only validated private preparation inputs, never caller-authored commands; launch-coordination owns the public launch route.

packages.name: launch-diagnostics
acceptance: Live/historical logs and non-Guardian crash reports retain useful classified outcomes and bounded redacted output.
Large/non-newline output, early exit, output-drain races and stale attempts cannot leak secrets or leave a false running state.

packages.name: launch-coordination
acceptance: An early checkpoint launches a real offline/Vanilla-mode instance through real account selection, settings, runtime, install and session owners; optional feature branches are not required to reach this checkpoint.

Full completion wires captured online identity, queued profile flush, retained Performance preparation, update/mutation exclusion and every failure outcome before spawn; private launch inputs cannot be forged by API callers.

Public launch routes call this coordinator. Each later online/profile/Performance branch requires its producer's reviewed private interface before development; those branches do not block the early offline checkpoint.

packages.name: offline-accounts
acceptance: Create/rename/select/remove preserve offline identity, selected launch mode and restart behavior.
Concurrent selection/removal has one coherent revisioned account snapshot.

packages.name: credential-store
acceptance: Production credentials remain in the OS keyring with explicit durable save/delete acknowledgement.
Ambiguous writes, unavailable keyring, interrupted refresh and logout cannot silently fall back to plaintext or resurrect removed tokens.

packages.name: microsoft-auth
acceptance: Sign-in/cancel, ownership/profile checks, refresh rotation, selection, sync and logout preserve account-bound behavior.
Callback/state/redirect validation and provider completion fences pass account-switch, logout and relogin races.

packages.name: content-catalog
acceptance: Modrinth search/detail/gallery/versions/hash-identification preserve mods, packs, shaders and resource-pack queries.
Filters, pagination, provider errors and cached/fresh results preserve exact identities and bounded input.

packages.name: content-resolution
acceptance: Targeted dependency plans preserve pins, required/optional dependencies, incompatibilities, cycles and user conflict decisions.
Expired or changed target plans are revalidated before install; no silent incompatible installation.

packages.name: content-mutation
acceptance: Install/update/uninstall retain exact file provenance and protect manually changed/unknown files.
Interrupted multi-file mutations compensate or preserve explicit unresolved obligations; metadata never invents atomic filesystem success.

packages.name: modpacks
acceptance: Both create-from-pack and selected-files import preserve loader declarations, client exclusions and override precedence.
Hostile archive paths, missing files, collisions and interrupted pack installation preserve existing instances and explicit recovery.

packages.name: media-admission
acceptance: Legacy/current skin and cape formats normalize with bounded image decoding.
Upload/drop identity, expiry, reuse, replacement and malformed/oversized image rejection are verified.

packages.name: skin-library
acceptance: Save/upload/edit/replace/delete/download/default deduplication preserve texture identity and metadata.
Publication/index failures preserve valid skins; replacement/removal informs pending changes without losing another account's choice.

packages.name: profile-media
acceptance: Lookup, heads, skins/capes, apply/reset, debounce, cancel and launch/shutdown flush preserve per-account intent.
Superseded completions and partial provider success have explicit outcomes; arbitrary texture URL fetches are rejected.

packages.name: mod-files
acceptance: Mod listing, enable/disable, delete and provenance updates preserve current resource behavior.
Portable-name collisions, active-session conflict and externally replaced files are rejected without unrelated changes.

packages.name: world-files
acceptance: World inventory/rename/delete/backup and existing folder/import affordances preserve expected data.
Mutation during unsafe lifecycle, backup publication failure and replaced paths preserve original worlds.

packages.name: screenshot-files
acceptance: Screenshot inventory/media/rename/delete retain byte content and canonical identity.
Collision, replaced file, missing file and media authorization cases have bounded safe outcomes.

packages.name: performance-plans
acceptance: Modes, inheritance, rules validation/refresh, declarative fallback, complete plans and health preserve non-Guardian semantics.
Untrusted rules or incomplete plans cannot become authorized managed mutations.

packages.name: performance-mutation
acceptance: Explicit apply/reapply/remove/rollback and snapshot selection retain ownership, exclusion and verified outcomes.
Compensation/restart retains indeterminate effects; Guardian supervision is replaced by mandatory domain admission, not bypassed.

packages.name: benchmarks
acceptance: Benchmark launches, matrices, suite drivers, stop/resume, qualification and non-Guardian reports remain.
Corrupt or future data is preserved and unavailable, not automatically quarantined; removed Guardian evidence cannot fake proof completeness.

packages.name: legacy-import
acceptance: Read-only inventory and idempotent staging/promotion import preserve supported settings, identities, user files and meaningful non-Guardian state.
Old profile/keyring stay unchanged; crashes between filesystem and metadata commit are recoverable; unsupported data is explicit and preserved.
Unsettled or unconvertible affected instances remain unavailable with exact obligations preserved; mutable external payload trees are copied independently rather than shared with the baseline.

packages.name: library-ui
acceptance: Recent/featured library, grid/list, filtering, context/bulk actions and status indicators retain current UX.
Navigation, empty/error/loading states and deletion confirmation work through real APIs and keyboard controls.

packages.name: create-ui
acceptance: Two-step overlay preserves source/channel/build/version selection, identity and effective defaults.
Discover staging and pack handoff preserve target choices, conflict/skipped-item explanation and post-create navigation.

packages.name: downloads-ui
acceptance: One active-download projection powers queue/progress/failure/retry/removal across views.
Reload/reconnect and stale terminal events converge without duplicated downloads or local failure-policy inference.

packages.name: session-ui
acceptance: Play/install/blocked/running/stop controls, elapsed state and latest/historical logs preserve operation behavior.
Stale events, startup failure, natural exit and stop show backend-authored state with actionable safe errors.

packages.name: accounts-ui
acceptance: Popover/modal account switcher, offline commands and Microsoft flows preserve selected identity and allowed actions.
Busy/error/cancel behavior survives rapid switching and failed refresh without stale profile updates.

packages.name: skins-ui
acceptance: Adapt existing wardrobe components in place; retain stage, defaults, saved skins, lookup, upload/edit/capes, queued apply and cancel.
Per-account selection, save-before-apply, preview-only tile clicks and bounded/offscreen rendering remain observable.

packages.name: discover-ui
acceptance: Filters/pagination/detail/versions/gallery, target bar, tray and modpack picker retain workflows.
Real backend checks target changes, conflict decisions, install/update/uninstall completion and navigation continuity.

packages.name: resource-ui
acceptance: Resource tabs, counts, filters, lightbox, selection/context/bulk actions and folder affordances retain current behavior.
Destructive actions retain explicit intent, busy refusal and failure state; shared instance resource registration has one integration owner.

packages.name: personalization
acceptance: Theme/accent, sound/slider/button behavior, music controls/cache, shortcuts and route preferences persist as intended.
Audio/media errors degrade without blocking bootstrap; no duplicate listeners/download flights or secret output.
Provide a minimal versioned preference export/import bridge that can run in the predecessor UI origin without redesign; verify retained preferences round-trip into the new application identity.

packages.name: settings-ui
acceptance: Onboarding and global/instance settings preserve autosave, inheritance/reset, appearance/audio/shortcut and runtime controls.
Guardian-only settings disappear while every unrelated preference remains; invalid input and save failures remain actionable.

packages.name: performance-ui
acceptance: Reuse existing Performance Lab components in place; retain current modes, health, benchmarks, drivers, qualification and non-Guardian history.
Mixed DTO changes preserve action availability and safe errors; do not invent user buttons for internal APIs without baseline evidence.

packages.name: updater
acceptance: Check/download/verify/stage/apply/restart and unsupported/busy/failure states preserve in-app behavior.
Corrupt or untrusted payloads cannot apply; installed updates preserve data and do not overlap active mutations.

packages.name: telemetry
acceptance: Consent, bounded closed events and frontend error reporting preserve non-Guardian behavior.
Disabled consent suppresses egress including error paths; public/telemetry outputs never include sensitive source data.

packages.name: developer-tools
acceptance: Flags, inspectors/playground, bounded command inspection and development reset retain their existing gating.
Release omits developer-only capabilities; reset uses an isolated development root and settles active work.

packages.name: discord-presence
acceptance: Configured integration publishes current sanitized presence and obeys the user setting.
Missing configuration, Discord absence and reconnect do not block launches or leak account/server data.

packages.name: artifact-delivery
acceptance: Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64, macOS x86_64 and arm64 artifacts install/start and perform a basic journey.
Version/tag/changelog, required artifacts, publisher authenticity, installed update and clean-machine native acceptance are evidenced without claiming unavailable signing authority.

packages.name: parity-integration
acceptance: Every retained API, UI, native, persisted and background coverage row has passing applicable real-dependency evidence.
Independent comparison detects wrong identities, reordered terminal state, lost persistence, missing features and unsafe file effects; full matrix has no unexplained differences.

packages.name: cutover-readiness
acceptance: Repeated import and installed update rehearsals preserve old data and the full retained feature matrix.
Candidate rollback/rescue procedure, known limits and source-to-artifact evidence are complete before any separately authorized publication.
